title: Dracula
description: The classic tale of Count Dracula, a vampire from Transylvania who travels to England to spread the undead curse and pursue his prey.

title: Frankenstein
description: A brilliant but obsessed scientist creates life from the dead, but his creation becomes a monster that terrorizes the countryside.

title: The House of Fear
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a series of mysterious deaths among members of a group called The Good Comrades.

title: The Woman in Green
description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a series of murders where the victims are found with their fingers severed, leading to a hypnotic conspiracy.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
description: A mysterious hypnotist uses a somnambulist to commit murders, in this groundbreaking German Expressionist horror film.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description: A disfigured musical genius lurks beneath the Paris Opera House, terrorizing the opera company and falling in love with a young soprano.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: A group of people hide from bloodthirsty zombies in a farmhouse, in this groundbreaking horror classic that launched the modern zombie genre.

title: The Last Man on Earth
description: The sole survivor of a plague that turned humanity into vampires struggles to find a cure while defending himself against the undead.

title: White Zombie
description: A young woman's fiance seeks help from a voodoo master to win her back, but the master has his own sinister plans for the bride.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A nerdy florist discovers a carnivorous plant that brings him success, but demands human blood to survive.
